categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes what the mining interface exposes and how it manages template locks, rather than IPC infrastructure itself, which the category explicitly excludes.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies the Mining interface (`interfaces/mining.h`, `mining.capnp`), `block_template_manager`, and miner tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a data race where concurrent IPC worker threads race when `submitSolution()` modifies an active template while another thread reads it (#36515). It also adds `getTotalFees()` to `interfaces::Mining` so external mining clients do not have to repeatedly query and sum transaction fees across the process boundary.
